entities.name: Mwonvuli Jungle
entities.description: A rain-soaked jungle across eastern Zhalfir, once taken by dark spirits and home to Jolrael's fortresses and the Amber Prison.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Plane which now includes the Mwonvuli Jungle.

entities.name: Jolrael
entities.description: The so-called Empress of Beasts, who had fortresses across the jungle.

entities.name: Mangara
entities.description: Held in the Amber Prison in Mwonvuli.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: Once met Mangara at the Mwonvuli Delta.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker who phased out the jungle.

entities.name: Mirage War
entities.description: War during which dark spirits took over Mwonvuli.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Teferi phased out the jungle.

entities.name: Amber Prison
entities.description: Prison in the jungle containing Mangara.

entities.name: Mwonvuli Delta
entities.description: River delta where Mangara and Kaervek once met.

events.summary: Dark spirits take over Mwonvuli during the Mirage War, after which it returns to a benign state.
events.quote: it was taken over by dark spirits during the Mirage War

events.summary: Teferi phases out the Mwonvuli Jungle during the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: The Mwonvuli Jungle was phased out by Teferi during the Phyrexian Invasion

relations.quote: sprawls across much of eastern Zhalfir
the location of the Amber Prison containing Mangara
